scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.deploy:staging:api: npm run prepare:lambda && node scripts/stage-sam-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/sam-deploy.mjs staging
scripts.deploy:preprod:api: npm run prepare:lambda && node scripts/stage-sam-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/sam-deploy.mjs preprod
scripts.deploy:production:api: npm run prepare:lambda && node scripts/stage-sam-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/sam-deploy.mjs production
